d:
The 76ers defeated the Pistons, 112-106 tonight in Detroit. Jaylen Brown contributed a team-high 30 points to go with 7 rebounds and 3 three pointers, with Joel Embiid of the 76ers adding an additional 26 points (8-18 FG) and 15 rebounds in the game. Duncan Robinson finished with a team-high 27 points along with 7 three pointers for the Pistons in the losing effort. The 76ers improve their record to 8-1 with the win, while the Pistons fall to 6-2 for the season.
